Seeing a lot of these “backlash to #MeToo “ articles saying that if bad dates are equated to rape, people will push back against the movement. 

1) Nobody is equating a bad date to rape. 
2) People who are “pushing back” would be pushing back regardless.

Hopefully the #MeToo movement will shed light on the fact that police are proportionally the biggest domestic abusers.
